title: Customer feedback interviews
description: Collect a score, the reason behind it, and a concrete follow-up while the customer still has the experience in mind.
workflow: Explain the purpose and expected length
Ask for a score, then invite context
Export the structured result for review
limitations: A voice interview does not make a sample representative
Do not record or infer sensitive traits without a documented need and consent

title: User research interviews
description: Run a consistent interview guide while preserving room for participants to explain their goals, workarounds, and mental models.
limitations: Automated summaries require researcher review
Do not treat a guided interview as a substitute for moderated research in high-risk studies

title: Conversational lead qualification
description: Gather need, context, timing, and fit in a guided conversation that produces a consistent record for human sales review.
workflow: State why the information is needed
Ask one qualification dimension at a time
Route the export for human review
limitations: Talkform should not make autonomous eligibility decisions
Avoid collecting unnecessary financial or sensitive personal data

title: Sales discovery intake
description: Prepare a discovery call with a structured account brief while letting prospects describe their situation in their own words.
limitations: A pre-call interview cannot replace relationship-building
Integration and security claims still need human validation

title: Customer onboarding intake
description: Capture goals, stakeholders, constraints, and implementation context before a kickoff so the team can spend the meeting on decisions.
workflow: Describe how answers will be used
Share the reviewed brief with the delivery team
limitations: Do not request credentials or secrets
Customers need a way to correct imported or transcribed details

title: Job application intake
description: Offer candidates a conversational path for role history and motivation while preserving an equivalent text option and human review.
workflow: Send results to trained human reviewers
limitations: Do not infer protected characteristics from voice
Employment decisions require legal review and meaningful human oversight

title: Project kickoff intake
description: Turn scattered pre-kickoff context into a structured brief covering outcomes, owners, dependencies, deadlines, and open questions.
limitations: The generated brief is a draft
Scope and contractual commitments require explicit human agreement

title: Support triage intake
description: Guide customers through symptoms, impact, environment, and attempted fixes before a support specialist reviews the case.
workflow: Warn users not to share passwords
Route by impact for human response
limitations: Do not claim automated resolution
Urgent safety or account-compromise reports need a separate escalation path

title: Education and learning intake
description: Collect learning goals, prior knowledge, constraints, and preferred support without treating a conversation as a formal assessment.
workflow: Explain how answers affect the learning plan
Let an educator review the result
limitations: Not a diagnostic or credentialing assessment
Minors and student records can trigger additional consent and privacy duties

title: Agency and creative briefs
description: Capture audience, problem, deliverables, constraints, references, and approval process in a client-friendly conversation.
workflow: Frame the brief as a draft
limitations: Referenced assets still need rights review
A generated brief is not a signed statement of work
